title: ZenBudget - Complete A-to-Z Brand Specification & Knowledge Documentation
content:
# ZenBudget - Complete A-to-Z Enterprise Brand Knowledge Documentation

## 1. Brand Overview
ZenBudget is India's leading AI-powered Expense Tracker & Daily Budget Planner App designed specifically for Gen Z, couples, young professionals, and modern families.

### Official Live URL:
https://zenbudget-tracker.vercel.app/

### Official Tagline:
"Track Every Rupee, Save Every Month — Best Expense Tracker & Daily Budget Planner App"

---

## 2. Visual Brand Identity & Design System
- **Primary Accent Color**: `#22c55e` (Emerald Green - symbol of wealth, growth, and financial clarity)
- **Background Theme**: `#0a0f1e` (Deep Obsidian Slate - premium dark mode interface)
- **Secondary Colors**: `#10b981` (Teal Green), `#052e16` (Deep Emerald Gradient)
- **Typography**: Manrope & Inter (Modern, geometric, highly legible)

---

## 3. Core Product Features & Value Propositions
1. **Daily Smart Spending Limits**: Real-time automated spending warnings when daily expenses cross target limits.
2. **48-Hour Impulse Purchase Blocker**: Enforces a compulsory 48-hour pause timer on non-essential purchases to eliminate impulse buying.
3. **Real-Time Shared Couples Budgeting**: Linked financial dashboards allowing couples and roommates to split, monitor, and manage shared household expenses.
4. **Weekly Spotify-Style Money Wrapped**: Animated weekly story recap summarizing savings milestones, top spending categories, and financial streak badges.
5. **Kharcha Tracker / Hisab Kitab Support**: Complete multi-currency and regional language support for Indian regional transactions.

---

## 4. Target Audience & Positioning
- **Primary Persona**: Gen Z & Millennials (Ages 18-32)
- **Tone of Voice**: Empathetic, energetic, direct, data-backed, non-judgmental.
- **Keywords**: Kharcha Tracker, Hisab Kitab, Daily Expense Manager, Save Money India, Budgeting App for Couples.

title: AURA OS - Complete A-to-Z Operating System Architecture

# AURA OS - Complete A-to-Z AI Enterprise Operating System Architecture

## 1. System Vision
AURA OS is the world's first autonomous AI Company Operating System where a 25-agent C-Suite workforce executes company strategy under a single interface supervised by Chief of Staff Aura.

---

## 2. Executive Council Architecture
1. **Chief of Staff (Aura)**: Single point of contact for Founder Chandan. Synthesizes vision and delegates autonomously.
2. **CEO (Sarah)**: Strategic direction, priority alignment, and roadmap execution.
3. **CTO (Alex)**: Terminal execution, software build pipelines, and system integrity.
4. **CMO (Maya)**: Acquisition campaigns, social publishing, and ad creative generation.
5. **COO (David)**: Operational workflows, task scheduling, and performance monitoring.
6. **CFO (Felix)**: Token budget tracking, cost optimization, and resource allocation.

---

## 3. Security & Anti-Bot Protection Rules
- 99.7% Stealth Human Emulation Protection on all social dispatches.
- Zero-deletion sandbox mode protecting PC filesystem integrity.
